en.description:
She lives inside your Bilibili and Douyin: following feeds, videos, dynamics, articles - likes, comments, replies to nested threads. DMs and group chats both work: you say one line and she picks it up within seconds; she can see and save images, and send the pictures she draws back to Douyin DMs, groups and comment sections. Plus a sticker library, a weekly recap and a local book library. Public actions have hard caps, and drafts wait for your approval by default.
